name: Sela
source:
Race: Female human
Origin: Laya Village
Hobby: Selling things
Job: Seller

Cihu's older sister and Laya Village's shopkeeper, Sela is often spotted selling things everywhere she goes. In OASE, Sela can be found in the Shopping Mall selling things. 

First appeared in Zeiva's early game series - Genetic Glow.
